dialogues.en: I couldn't sleep because I was thinking about many things.
dialogues.text: I couldn't sleep because I was thinking about many things.

dialogues.en: The first day I met her.
dialogues.text: The first day I met her.

dialogues.jp:
うとうとしかけたのは、窓から日が射し込んで
来た頃だったと思う。
dialogues.en:
The touch I felt when I held her in my arms on the veranda
by accident.
dialogues.text:
The touch I felt when I held her in my arms on the veranda
by accident.

dialogues.jp:
丸１日以上眠ったんでなければ、ほとんど眠っ
てないことになる。
dialogues.en: The taste of the curry and rice she made for me.
dialogues.text: The taste of the curry and rice she made for me.

dialogues.jp:
時計に目を遣ると、目覚ましが鳴る１０分ほど
前だった。
dialogues.en: Her tears when she came to see me at the hospital.
dialogues.text: Her tears when she came to see me at the hospital.

dialogues.jp:
頭の芯が重たかった。その重みは色々の想いだ。
頼子さんとの。
dialogues.en: The door opens.
dialogues.text: The door opens.

dialogues.jp:
色んな場面が思い出されて、俺をなかなか寝つ
けさせなかった。
初めて出会った時のこと。
dialogues.en: "......Good morning."
dialogues.text: "......Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……おはよ」
dialogues.en: "......Your eyes are red."
dialogues.text: "......Your eyes are red."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I have a pollen allergy. Same as you?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I have a pollen allergy. Same as you?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……目、赤いですよ？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I do too."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I do too."

dialogues.jp:
ぐぐっと伸びをして、反動を付け、ベッドから
起きあがる。
dialogues.en:
I stretch and get out of bed. And I tell her while pointing
at the alarm clock,
dialogues.text:
I stretch and get out of bed. And I tell her while pointing
at the alarm clock,

dialogues.jp: 時計にあごをしゃくって、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: "I still have 10 more minutes."
dialogues.text: "I still have 10 more minutes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その……余裕をもって起こそうと思った
　んです。時間をかけて」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, yes, you do...... But I was coming to wake you up well
in advance so that I can take time to do it."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, yes, you do...... But I was coming to wake you up well
in advance so that I can take time to do it."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「時間をかけて？」
dialogues.en: "Take time to wake me up?"
dialogues.text: "Take time to wake me up?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい。……ゆっくりと」
dialogues.en: "Yes. ......You know, slowly and gently."
dialogues.text: "Yes. ......You know, slowly and gently."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……なるほど。それもいいな。じゃ、眠り直
　そうか」
dialogues.en:
"......I see. I like the sound of that. Then I should get
back to sleep."
dialogues.text:
"......I see. I like the sound of that. Then I should get
back to sleep."

dialogues.jp: 布団に潜り込んだ時だった。
dialogues.en: And just as I get back into bed,
dialogues.text: And just as I get back into bed,

dialogues.jp: じりりり……。
dialogues.en: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!
dialogues.text: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

dialogues.jp: 「残念、時間だ」
dialogues.en: "Shoot. It's time now."
dialogues.text: "Shoot. It's time now."

dialogues.jp:
ガムテープで固定してある目覚ましに、軽く
チョップを喰らわせる。
dialogues.en:
I give a karate-chop to my alarm clock that's secured with
tape to the desk.
dialogues.text:
I give a karate-chop to my alarm clock that's secured with
tape to the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ええ……ほんとに、残念ですね……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... it's unfortunate indeed."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... it's unfortunate indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「では、朝食の用意はもう出来ていますから」
dialogues.en: "Breakfast is ready."
dialogues.text: "Breakfast is ready."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ふう……何だろ。眠いせいかな。目がしょぼ
　しょぼしやがる……」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm...... What's this? My eyes are watery...... Is it
because I'm sleepy?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm...... What's this? My eyes are watery...... Is it
because I'm sleepy?"

dialogues.jp:
ぐりぐりと拳を目にあて、ベッドから降り立っ
た。視界が｛にじ／滲｝んでいる。
dialogues.en:
I rub my eyes with my fists as I get out of bed. My vision's
still blurry.
dialogues.text:
I rub my eyes with my fists as I get out of bed. My vision's
still blurry.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよー」
dialogues.en: "Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの席に着くと、コーヒーカップがすっ
と置かれた。
dialogues.en:
As I sit at the table, she quickly puts my coffee cup in
front of me.
dialogues.text:
As I sit at the table, she quickly puts my coffee cup in
front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「さんきゅ。……ん、何？」
dialogues.en: "Thank you.......Wh-What?"
dialogues.text: "Thank you.......Wh-What?"

dialogues.jp:
口元をじっと見つめてくる頼子さんに、カップ
を手にしたまま首を傾げる。
dialogues.en:
Holding my coffee cup in my hand, I cock my head at her,
because Yoriko-san keeps staring at my mouth.
dialogues.text:
Holding my coffee cup in my hand, I cock my head at her,
because Yoriko-san keeps staring at my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その……前から不思議に思っていたんで
　すが……」
dialogues.en: "I...... I have been curious for a long time......"
dialogues.text: "I...... I have been curious for a long time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん？」
dialogues.en: "About what?"
dialogues.text: "About what?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「インスタントコーヒーって、その……美味し
　いですか？」
dialogues.en: "Does that instant coffee taste...... good?"
dialogues.text: "Does that instant coffee taste...... good?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「まあ……まずくはないけど。インスタントは
　苦手？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh...... it doesn't taste bad. You don't like instant
coffee?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh...... it doesn't taste bad. You don't like instant
coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "No, not really......"
dialogues.text: "No, not really......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、今度、コーヒーメーカーでも──」
dialogues.en: "Then, I can get you a coffee machine..."
dialogues.text: "Then, I can get you a coffee machine..."

dialogues.jp: 言いかけて、のどが凍り付いた。
dialogues.en: My tongue gets in a twist as I speak.
dialogues.text: My tongue gets in a twist as I speak.

dialogues.jp:
「コーヒーメーカーも、良いやつは割と高いん
　だよな……」
dialogues.en:
"But those coffee machines are very expensive these
days......"
dialogues.text:
"But those coffee machines are very expensive these
days......"

dialogues.jp:
むにゃむにゃとそんなことを呟き、カップを傾
ける。
dialogues.en: I murmur ambiguously with a sip of coffee.
dialogues.text: I murmur ambiguously with a sip of coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「夕飯は、何が食べたいですか？」
dialogues.en: "What would you like to have for dinner tonight?"
dialogues.text: "What would you like to have for dinner tonight?"

dialogues.jp:
湿っぽさのない声音で｛たず／訊｝ねてくる。何だか救わ
れたような気になって、カップをテーブルに、
置いた。
dialogues.en:
She asks me as if she didn't hear what I just said. I feel
saved and put my coffee cup on the table.
dialogues.text:
She asks me as if she didn't hear what I just said. I feel
saved and put my coffee cup on the table.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……。カレーなんかいいかも」
dialogues.en: "Let me think...... I'd like to have curry and rice."
dialogues.text: "Let me think...... I'd like to have curry and rice."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「分かりました。……腕によりをかけますから、
　楽しみにしていて下さいね」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. ......I'll do my best to cook it for you. Please look
forward to it."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. ......I'll do my best to cook it for you. Please look
forward to it."

dialogues.jp: 浮かべた笑顔に、俺はこくりと頷いた。
dialogues.en: I nod back to her smile.
dialogues.text: I nod back to her smile.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Have a nice day."
dialogues.text: "Have a nice day."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「行ってきます」
dialogues.en: "You too."
dialogues.text: "You too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「グッド・モーニング！」
dialogues.en: "Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……もーにん」
dialogues.en: "Morning."
dialogues.text: "Morning."

dialogues.jp: 投げやりな挨拶を返して、そのまま通り過ぎる。
dialogues.en: I walk past her uncaringly.
dialogues.text: I walk past her uncaringly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ？　どうしたのかな？　元気ないなー」
dialogues.en: "What? What's wrong? You look down."
dialogues.text: "What? What's wrong? You look down."

dialogues.jp:
てこてこと横について歩きながら、顔を覗き込
んでくる。
dialogues.en: She peers at my face, walking briskly to follow me.
dialogues.text: She peers at my face, walking briskly to follow me.

dialogues.jp: 「……朝は、寝起きが悪いんだよ」
dialogues.en: "......I'm not a morning person."
dialogues.text: "......I'm not a morning person."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、頼子ちゃんから話、聞いた？」
dialogues.en: "Are you down because Yoriko-chan told you about it?"
dialogues.text: "Are you down because Yoriko-chan told you about it?"

dialogues.jp: ちびっこいさくらを見下ろす。
dialogues.en: I look at little Sakura.
dialogues.text: I look at little Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「そういや、お前、公園で何か喋ってたっけか」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, yeah, I remember you were talking to her at the park
the other day."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, yeah, I remember you were talking to her at the park
the other day."

dialogues.jp: ｛ずがいこつ／頭蓋骨｝をわしっと掴み、上に引っ張る。
dialogues.en: I grab her head roughly and pull her up.
dialogues.text: I grab her head roughly and pull her up.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あややや！　も、もげるっ」
dialogues.en: "Ooooouch! You're gonna pull my head off!"
dialogues.text: "Ooooouch! You're gonna pull my head off!"

dialogues.jp:
爪先立ちで、さくらが両手をぱたぱたさせる。
一つため息をつき、頭を解放した。
dialogues.en:
She's on her toes, flapping her arms up and down. I give a
sigh and let her head go.
dialogues.text:
She's on her toes, flapping her arms up and down. I give a
sigh and let her head go.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいか。んなことはどうだって」
dialogues.en: "Well, you know what? I don't care."
dialogues.text: "Well, you know what? I don't care."

dialogues.jp:
ととと、と小走りに俺の正面に回り込んだ。思
わず、立ち止まる。
dialogues.en: She trots around in front of me and stops me.
dialogues.text: She trots around in front of me and stops me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あの桜を枯らすのはね、ボクなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm the one who can kill the cherry tree."
dialogues.text: "I'm the one who can kill the cherry tree."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　何だって？　……おい、ちょっと待て。
　お前、背中に何隠してるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"What? What did you just say? ...... Wait a minute. What are
you hiding behind your back?"
dialogues.text:
"What? What did you just say? ...... Wait a minute. What are
you hiding behind your back?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらの小さな身体の陰に、何かがちらりと見
えた。
dialogues.en: I saw her hiding something behind her back.
dialogues.text: I saw her hiding something behind her back.

dialogues.jp: 「……野球でも始めるのか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you gonna start playing baseball or something?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you gonna start playing baseball or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃっ？　こ、これは……お、おいっちにー、
　さんしー」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh, th-this... One, two, three. One, two, three."
dialogues.text: "What? Oh, th-this... One, two, three. One, two, three."

dialogues.jp:
バットを両手に持ち、身体を妙な具合に、くね
くね動かし始めた。
dialogues.en:
Holding the ends of the metal bat, she starts to move her
body from side to side as if she's stretching her back with
it.
dialogues.text:
Holding the ends of the metal bat, she starts to move her
body from side to side as if she's stretching her back with
it.

dialogues.jp: 「アホらし……」
dialogues.en: "Stupid......"
dialogues.text: "Stupid......"

dialogues.jp: その横をすっと通り過ぎ、道を進む。
dialogues.en: I quietly walk past her.
dialogues.text: I quietly walk past her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから、ボクが、秘密基地の桜を枯らすのっ」
dialogues.en: "I said I can kill the cherry tree at your secret hideout."
dialogues.text: "I said I can kill the cherry tree at your secret hideout."

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、仁王立ちになったさくらがバット
を剣のように構えていた。
dialogues.en:
As I turn around, Sakura's standing to her full height,
holding the bat up high as if it's a sword.
dialogues.text:
As I turn around, Sakura's standing to her full height,
holding the bat up high as if it's a sword.

dialogues.jp: ……何考えているのやら。
dialogues.en: ...What the hell is she thinking about?
dialogues.text: ...What the hell is she thinking about?

dialogues.jp: 「ま、とにかく歩こうぜ。遅刻する。……俺が」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's just go. We...... I mean I'll be late."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's just go. We...... I mean I'll be late."

dialogues.jp:
道の向こう側に、くいっとあごをやり、背中を
向けた。
dialogues.en: I look down the road and turn my back to her.
dialogues.text: I look down the road and turn my back to her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれれれ？　何で？　何で？　怒らないの？」
dialogues.en:
Since Sakura quit school, she's been sloppy. And I've no
idea what's on her mind......
dialogues.text:
Since Sakura quit school, she's been sloppy. And I've no
idea what's on her mind......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何を怒るってんだよ。かったるい」
dialogues.en: "Whhhhat? Why? Why? Why don't you get mad?"
dialogues.text: "Whhhhat? Why? Why? Why don't you get mad?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だって、あの桜が枯れたら、頼子ちゃんは消
　えちゃうんだよ？　あんだすたん？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you mad?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you mad?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en:
"You should be mad, because if the cherry tree dies,
Yoriko-chan will disappear. DO YOU UNDERSTAND?"
dialogues.text:
"You should be mad, because if the cherry tree dies,
Yoriko-chan will disappear. DO YOU UNDERSTAND?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ふ〜ん……。せっかく、金属バットだって用
　意したのにな……」
dialogues.en:
"Huh...... I brought this metal bat all the way here for
nothing..."
dialogues.text:
"Huh...... I brought this metal bat all the way here for
nothing..."

dialogues.jp: こんこんと、先端を爪先でけっ飛ばした。
dialogues.en: She kicks the end of the bat with her toes.
dialogues.text: She kicks the end of the bat with her toes.

dialogues.jp: 「あんなあ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you."

dialogues.jp: 望み通り、怒ったような声で俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I make the angry voice she wanted.
dialogues.text: I make the angry voice she wanted.

dialogues.jp:
「お前の思惑はお前のものだろ。俺達二人には、
　関係がないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Your interest is yours. It has nothing to do with us."
dialogues.text: "Your interest is yours. It has nothing to do with us."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ、何それ！　ひっどい言い草！」
dialogues.en: "What! You're so mean!"
dialogues.text: "What! You're so mean!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「知るか」
dialogues.en: "I don't care."
dialogues.text: "I don't care."

dialogues.jp: 歩を早め、校門へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I keep walking to the gate.
dialogues.text: I keep walking to the gate.

dialogues.jp:
実際のところ、さくらの考えなど知ったことじゃ
ないのだ。
dialogues.en:
As a matter of fact, I really don't care what Sakura has on
her mind.
dialogues.text:
As a matter of fact, I really don't care what Sakura has on
her mind.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんが消えると告げ、俺がそれを受け入れ
た。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san told me that she has to disappear, and I accepted
it.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san told me that she has to disappear, and I accepted
it.

dialogues.jp: 重要なのは、そこの部分だけ。
dialogues.en: That's the only important thing about it.
dialogues.text: That's the only important thing about it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど小走りになって、俺の横に並んだ。俺
は足を緩めた。
dialogues.en:
She runs after me and comes right up beside me. I slow down
my pace for her.
dialogues.text:
She runs after me and comes right up beside me. I slow down
my pace for her.

dialogues.jp: 「まだ、何かあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What else do you want?"
dialogues.text: "What else do you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクのこと……嫌いにならないでよね」
dialogues.en: "Please don't...... hate me, please?"
dialogues.text: "Please don't...... hate me, please?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……とりあえず、頭上に振り上げたバットを
　下ろしてくれたらな」
dialogues.en:
"......I won't if you put down your metal bat that you just
raised above my head."
dialogues.text:
"......I won't if you put down your metal bat that you just
raised above my head."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゃ？　てへへ……ＮＯって言ったら、ぶっ
　叩こうかと思って」
dialogues.en:
"What? Ha-ha-ha...... I was just getting ready to hit you if
you said you would hate me."
dialogues.text:
"What? Ha-ha-ha...... I was just getting ready to hit you if
you said you would hate me."

dialogues.jp: 死ぬ。
dialogues.en: She was gonna kill me.
dialogues.text: She was gonna kill me.

dialogues.jp: 「別に、嫌いにはならねえよ」
dialogues.en: "I won't hate you."
dialogues.text: "I won't hate you."

dialogues.jp:
さくらの表情から、こいつはこいつで、何かを
抱えているんだと悟った。
dialogues.en:
I realize from the expression on her face that she's having
some problems.
dialogues.text:
I realize from the expression on her face that she's having
some problems.

dialogues.jp:
今の俺は、それを一緒に支えることは出来ない
けれど……。
dialogues.en: But I can't support her right now.
dialogues.text: But I can't support her right now.

dialogues.jp:
「おら、さっさと行こうぜ。さっきも言ったけ
　ど、遅刻するっての」
dialogues.en: "Let's just go now. Like I said, I'll be late."
dialogues.text: "Let's just go now. Like I said, I'll be late."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらが桜を◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
いつも通りの朝。俺と頼子さんは、無理矢理に
でもいつも通りの日常を送る。
dialogues.en: "It's morning already......"
dialogues.text: "It's morning already......"

dialogues.jp: 家を出て学校に向かう途中、さくらに出会った。
dialogues.en: It was close to dawn when I finally felt sleepy.
dialogues.text: It was close to dawn when I finally felt sleepy.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、珍しく神妙な面持ちにで、あの願い
の桜を枯らすのは自分なんだと俺に告げるのだっ
た。
dialogues.en: It means that I haven't slept for 24 hours.
dialogues.text: It means that I haven't slept for 24 hours.

dialogues.jp:
あの願いの桜が枯れたとき、頼子さんは消えて
しまうらしい。
dialogues.en:
I look at my alarm clock, and I still have 10 more minutes
till the time I'm supposed to wake up.
dialogues.text:
I look at my alarm clock, and I still have 10 more minutes
till the time I'm supposed to wake up.

dialogues.jp:
でも、誰が悪いとか、そんな事は関係なかった。
頼子さんが消えると告げ、俺はそれを受け入れ
た。
dialogues.en: "......I am so sleepy."
dialogues.text: "......I am so sleepy."

dialogues.jp: ただ、それだけなんだ。
dialogues.en:
I feel heaviness deep within my head. The heaviness is
coming from my thoughts about Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
I feel heaviness deep within my head. The heaviness is
coming from my thoughts about Yoriko-san.
